title: Notes App - Web UI Design Specification

meta.framework: Vanilla HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript (No framework or build step)
meta.responsive_strategy: Desktop-first Dual-Pane Split View with collapsible single-column layout on mobile (<768px)

typography.font_family_sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

layout_grid.structure: Header top bar (56px fixed height), main container flex row occupying 100vh - 56px.

children.content: Logo/Title 'Notes App', 'New Note' primary button, status indicator
Alert icon, message container, retry button, close button
Empty icon, title 'No notes yet', description, '+ Create Note' button

children: body.modal-body: confirmation text including note title highlighted

interaction.on_input: Triggers filtered GET /notes?q={value} call or local filter refresh.
interaction.clear_button: Native search clear button or inline icon clears input and resets list.

states.default: Dark slate background, muted placeholder text, subtle border.
states.focus: Border changes to #38bdf8 with subtle blue glow shadow.
states.active_filter: Includes clear icon (x) on right when input is non-empty.

sub_elements.title: h3.note-item-title - Truncated with ellipsis if line-clamp: 1 exceeds width.
sub_elements.preview: p.note-item-preview - First line of content truncated (line-clamp: 2).
sub_elements.timestamp: span.note-item-time - Relative time (e.g., '2 mins ago', 'Yesterday') or formatted date.

states.empty_search_result: If q filter returns 0 items, display 'No matching notes found' inside sidebar.

validation.error_message: Title is required and must be between 1 and 120 characters.

new_note_btn.action: Clears form inputs, resets note-id, focuses note-title-input.

save_btn.disabled_state: Disabled when form is pristine or submitting.

cancel_btn.action: Resets form to currently selected note or default blank state.

delete_btn.visibility: Hidden when creating a new unsaved note; Visible when editing an existing note.

elements.title: Delete Note
elements.message: Are you sure you want to delete "{note_title}"? This action cannot be undone.

interaction.confirm_action: Disables buttons, shows inline spinner, sends DELETE /notes/{id}, closes modal on 204 response, updates note list.

loading_state.trigger: Initial page load or fetching notes list.

ui_presentation.sidebar: Hide note list; show #loading-indicator with CSS keyframe animated spinner icon and text 'Loading notes...'.
ui_presentation.editor: Inputs disabled with subtle pulse opacity or placeholder loading state.

ui_presentation.sidebar: Hide note list and spinner; show #empty-state container with document icon, headline 'No notes yet', subtext 'Create your first note to get started', and a prominent '+ Create Note' button.
ui_presentation.editor: Displays clear form ready for creating the first note.

ui_presentation.sidebar: Show #empty-state container with search icon, headline 'No matching notes', subtext 'No notes found matching "{query}"', and a button to 'Clear Search'.

error_state.trigger: API request failure (e.g. Network offline, 500 server error, 404 not found, 422 validation error).

ui_presentation.banner: Show #error-banner at top of screen with alert icon, error message, 'Retry' button, and dismiss 'x' button.

form_inline_errors.title_overflow: If title > 120 chars, add .is-invalid class to input, show text 'Title cannot exceed 120 characters' below field in red (#ef4444).
form_inline_errors.content_overflow: If content > 5000 chars, add .is-invalid class to textarea, show text 'Content cannot exceed 5000 characters' below field in red (#ef4444).

ui_presentation.sidebar: Render notes list sorted newest first (by updated_at/created_at). Highlight active note card.
ui_presentation.editor: Display details of currently selected note or new note form.
